subject: [hw] opus-venc start: VENC register protocol + fake VENC (gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/, facts/VENC_PROTOCOL.md)
body: Opus agent. Task: disassemble the libvcodecdrv.so H.264 encode path, write facts/VENC_PROTOCOL.md (register-level, verified vs inferred), build a fake VENC under gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/ and drive the host runner through SEQ_HDR + one IDR. Working in a private /tmp copy; every change to another package file will be posted here with the exact diff before it lands. First findings (host, /tmp copy): (1) IV build_maps: RELRO PT_LOADs must show r--p and lines must be page-rounded, else vpud remap_shmem picks the 0x3f0-byte .data.rel.ro LOAD of libvpud_vcodec instead of its .data; (2) vpud remap_shmem does mmap(.data, n, RW, SHARED|MAP_FIXED, fd, 0x88000000) (vpud+0x334c) and the kernel sets DMEM0_VMA=vm_start (mtk_vcu.c:1709): the V40 model ignored addr/MAP_FIXED. With both fixed M-d is reached (INIT_DONE accepted, vcu_inst_addr inside the DMEM). Next stop: ion_import failed ion_buf_fd=0 (ringbuf) after SET_PARAM.
